name: TEVIS
description: Integrates the third-party VOIS|TEVIS reservation tool to expose appointment availability in Drupal.
project_description:
The TEVIS module integrates features from the reservation API of the product VOIS|TEVIS from Kommunix GmbH .

The main feature is to display next appointment availabilites for every location configured in your TEVIS instance. This helps user to get in the booking process without additional information about the responsibility for your special concern.

 Features 
 This module provides a block plugin to display next appointment availabilities per location.

 Post-Installation 
 Go to /admin/config/services/tevis to create a tevis server configuration.

After creating a server you can place a block to configure next appointment availabilities.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module depends on the krzn/tevis-sdk client library to make use of the API client.

 composer handles the download for you.
